senses.gloss:
ITA-5.76.144 snātaśirasaḥ nasya vyāpadaḥ स्नातशिरसः नस्य व्यापदः
Condition due to inhalation therapy administered to person who has taken a head bath
A condition characterized by cold catarrh.

ITA-5.75.6 snāna-vaiṣamyam स्नान-वैषम्यम्
Disorder due to improper bathing habits

ITA-3.13.55 snāyuḥ स्नायुः
Sinews
Tendons, ligaments and other fibrous connective tissue.

ITA-5.73.6 snāyugata-śalyaḥ स्नायुगत-शल्यः
Foreign body in the ligaments, and tendons
A disorder due to presence of foreign body in the ligaments; characterized by redness/congestion/inflammation; forceful flow of fluid on cutting tendons; associated with severe pain.

ITA-5.2.1.22 snāyugatavātaḥ स्नायुगतवातः
Aggravation of vata in tendons and ligaments.
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: external bending of body, internal bending of body; shooting pain in extremities; kyphosis; quadriplegia; monoplegia; rigidity/stiffness; tremors; sharp pain; convulsions; sciatica.

ITA-3.13.69 snāyujālam स्नायुजालम्
Network of tendons

ITA-3.13.56 snāyupratānaḥ स्नायुप्रतानः
Network of sinews

ITA-3.16.14 Snāyumarma स्नायुमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) in which the main structural component is tendon
Marma where fibrous connective tissue is structurally prominent

ITA-5.73.21 snāyuviddhaḥ स्नायुविद्धः
Penetrating or puncturing A disorder characterized by a flexion deformity/humpback; deep injury to ligaments inability to move; a slowly healing wound; severe pain; weakness of limbs.

ITA-5.66.51 snāyvarma स्नाय्वर्म
Tumour of conjunctiva
A disorder characterized by rough muscular growth; excessively white muscular growth; muscular growth resembling tendons; spreading in nature; swelling associated with abundant fleshy tissue; dry tissue; fixed swelling.
